messages:
anya: small but annoying DX bug from today: our starter kit's auth section has three different examples for environment vars (REDWOOD_KEY, RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY). New contractor spent 30m switching between them. can we pick one canonical name and follow through?

rob: agreed. this inconsistency leaks into the CLI and a few SDK READMEs. my vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY is explicit and matches product name. also add REDWOOD_PROJECT for opt-in scoping.

felix: compatibility note: some internal infra scripts still set REDWOOD_KEY. we should have a clear migration path and runtime warnings for ambiguous configs.

maya: proposal: precedence = explicit constructor arg > env var REDWOOD_API_KEY > env var REDWOOD_KEY (legacy) > ~/.config/redwood/credentials.json profile > SDK named profiles. Log one warning per process when legacy var found. Also emit deprecation header in docs with a date.

oscar: SDK action items: add a Creds.read_precedence() test, update quickstart code snippets, and modify CLI to print where it's loading credentials from when `--verbose-auth` set. I'll take the JS and Go SDKs.

cli-bot: created task AD-712: "Normalize env var names and doc migration (REDWOOD_API_KEY canonical)" — https://tracker.redwood-inference.internal/AD-712

anya: thanks — can we also update starter-kit .env.example to show both the preferred var and the legacy var with a note? small change but huge onboarding win.

rob: yeah I'll land the .env and README tweaks. let's set deprecation to 2025-09-01 to give internal scripts time.

felix: pinging infra owners to sweep scripts and add a tiny helper that copies REDWOOD_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY on CI until deprecation date.

maya: perfect. target: patch in this sprint, SDK warnings next sprint. thanks all :rocket:
